Package dev.shvquu.betternpcs.api.npc.property

Klasse TextDisplayStyle

java.lang.Object
dev.shvquu.betternpcs.api.npc.property.TextDisplayStyle
public final class TextDisplayStyle extends Object
The visual style shared by every piece of floating text an NPC renders — its nametag and its hologram lines.

Extracted into its own type because the two differ only in what they say and where they sit, not in how they look. A server that wants a house style sets one of these up and reuses it.

Several options only exist on servers new enough to have text display entities. Where they do not, the version adapter falls back to armour stands and ignores what it cannot honour rather than failing; requiresTextDisplays() reports whether a style depends on that support.

Instances are immutable and safe to share across threads.

Seit:
1.0.0

    • requiresTextDisplays

      public boolean requiresTextDisplays()
      Returns whether this style uses anything an armour stand fallback cannot reproduce.

      An armour stand can show one line of coloured text and nothing else. Scaling, backgrounds, opacity, alignment and billboard constraints all need a real text display entity, so a style that changes any of them will render only approximately on a server without them.

      Gibt zurück:
      true if this style needs text display entity support
